title: Takht Sri Patna Sahib Gurudwara - A Sacred Sikh Shrine in Patna
content:
Takht Sri Patna Sahib Gurudwara 

Takht Sri Patna Sahib, also known as Harmandir Sahib, Patna, is one of the five Takhts (seats of authority) of Sikhism. Located in Patna, Bihar, this holy shrine marks the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the tenth Sikh Guru. It is not only a place of deep spiritual importance but also a symbol of peace, faith, and unity.

History and Significance

The gurudwara was built by Maharaja Ranjit Singh in the 18th century to honor the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, who was born here in 1666.
Takht Sri Patna Sahib holds immense historical and religious importance, as it preserves the belongings, weapons, and sacred writings associated with the Guru. Pilgrims from across the world visit this shrine to pay their respects and experience its divine atmosphere.

Architecture

The architecture of the gurudwara is a perfect blend of Sikh and Mughal styles, featuring white marble walls, golden domes, and intricately carved interiors. The shrine’s sanctum is adorned with holy scriptures and relics of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, making it a truly spiritual experience for every visitor.

Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to visit Takht Sri Patna Sahib is between October and March, when the weather is pleasant. The gurudwara comes alive during major Sikh festivals like Gurpurab and Baisakhi, with beautiful decorations and devotional music (kirtan).

Entry Fee and Timings

  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Timings: Open 24 hours for devotees
  • Aarti/Kirtan: Morning and evening sessions

How to Reach

  • By Air: The nearest airport is Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, about 15 km away.
  • By Train: Patna Sahib Railway Station is just 2 km from the gurudwara.
  • By Road: Easily accessible by taxi, auto, or local bus from any part of Patna.

Nearby Attractions

  • Golghar - A historic granary with panoramic views
  • Patna Museum - Showcasing Bihar’s rich cultural heritage
  • Gandhi Maidan - A large historical ground in the city center
  • Kumhrar Park - Ancient ruins from the Mauryan period

Why Visit Takht Sri Patna Sahib

A visit to Takht Sri Patna Sahib offers peace, devotion, and spiritual enlightenment. Whether you are a devotee or a traveler seeking cultural depth, this sacred site connects you to Sikh heritage and India’s spiritual traditions.

faqs.question: Why is Takht Sri Patna Sahib famous?
faqs.answer: It is famous as the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the tenth Sikh Guru, and one of the five Takhts of Sikhism.

faqs.question: Who built the Patna Sahib Gurudwara?
faqs.answer: It was built by Maharaja Ranjit Singh in memory of Guru Gobind Singh Ji.

faqs.question: What is the entry fee for visiting the gurudwara?
faqs.answer: There is no entry fee; entry is free for all visitors.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Patna Sahib?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit is from October to March or during Sikh festivals like Gurpurab and Baisakhi.

faqs.question: Is accommodation available near the gurudwara?
faqs.answer: Yes, the gurudwara provides sarai (guest house) facilities for pilgrims and visitors.
